verdict.rationale: Full-disk encryption is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions FileVault, disk encryption, or encryption being turned on automatically during setup. The only security-related doc mentions general built-in protection tools such as password management and private browsing, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a switcher, I get full-disk encryption enabled automatically without manual security setup
